name: Table
description: Data table with quiet hairlines, uppercase headers, hover rows, inline row actions and multi-select. Styles plain table elements under .ayy-table.

classes.ayy-table-wrap: Scroll container around the table (horizontal overflow).
classes.ayy-table__num: On th/td with numbers: end-aligned, tabular digits.
classes.ayy-table__sort: A <button> inside a sortable <th>, with an arrow drawn after the text. aria-sort="ascending" or "descending" on the <th> marks the sorted column; the others show both arrows, faint.
classes.ayy-table__select: On the th/td holding a row's checkbox (and the select-all box in the header): as narrow as the box.
classes.ayy-table__actions: On the trailing th/td holding a row's inline action buttons and ⋯ overflow menu trigger: end-aligned, as narrow as its controls.
classes.ayy-table__row-actions: Inline-flex cluster of row action buttons and overflow menu trigger inside an .ayy-table__actions cell.
classes.ayy-table__row-actions--reveal: Reveals quick actions when the row is hovered, focused within, selected or has an open menu (stays visible on touch screens).

default.looks: Collapsed table, s text; header row on a wash fill with muted s uppercase labels; hairlines between rows.

hover.looks: Row gets a wash fill and reveals .ayy-table__row-actions--reveal; a sort button's label turns text colour.

disabled.none: Rows aren't disabled; disable the controls in them.

selected.looks: Wash-hover row fill. Forced colours: Highlight.

error.none: Show a failed load as an Alert with a retry instead of the rows.

loading.none: No loading look; render Skeleton rows in the column layout with aria-busy on the table.

sorted.looks: Header label turns text colour and only the arrow that applies shows, at full strength. Forced colours: underlined.

sizes.density: Header cells are 2.25rem tall, cells padded 12px; compact makes headers 2rem and cells tighter. Text size follows data-density via --ayy-text-s.
sizes.width: Fills its .ayy-table-wrap, which scrolls sideways when the columns don't fit.

js: tableClass({ compact?, className? }); tableRowActionsClass({ reveal?, className? }); tableWrapClass, tableNumClass, tableSortClass, tableSelectClass, tableActionsClass constants; nextSortDirection(current) → "ascending" | "descending"; compareValues(a, b) sorts numbers (also "$1,240", "12 GB") by value and text with digits read as numbers; connectTable(table, { onSort?, onSelectionChange? }) wires sort buttons and row checkboxes on plain markup (used by <ayy-table>).

element.description: Wraps an .ayy-table (or its .ayy-table-wrap). Header .ayy-table__sort buttons set aria-sort and reorder the body rows by that column (a cell's data-sort-value wins over its text); .ayy-table__select checkboxes set aria-selected on their row, and a checkbox in the header's select cell selects all and shows some as indeterminate.

events.ayy-sort: { column, key, direction } before the rows move — key is the <th>'s data-sort-key. Call preventDefault() to sort them yourself (on the server).

react.import: import { Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableRowActions, TableCaption } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

TableHead.renders: <th scope="col">, with a <button class="ayy-table__sort"> inside when sortable

props.actions: boolean — the trailing row actions column
props.sort: "ascending" | "descending" | "none" — makes the header a sort button; "none" for a sortable column that isn't sorted
props.onSort: () => void — flip with nextSortDirection() and sort your rows (compareValues helps)

props.actions: boolean — the trailing row actions column

props.reveal: boolean — reveal on row hover, focus-within or selection (stays visible on touch)

a11y: Use real <th> header cells with scope (React sets scope="col").
A <caption> or aria-label names the table for screen readers.
Sorting is a button inside the header, so it's reachable by Tab and announced with the column's aria-sort. Only the sorted column carries aria-sort.
Every row checkbox needs an aria-label naming its row ("Select INV-1042"); the select-all box is indeterminate when some rows are selected.
Row action icon buttons and ⋯ menu triggers need an aria-label that names the row ("Edit Northwind", "More actions for Northwind").
do: Use a table to compare items across the same attributes (projects × status × builds).
Keep cell content short; truncate with a tooltip if needed.
Make the columns people scan sortable (names, dates, amounts), and start sorted by the most useful one. Put the real value in data-sort-value when the cell shows a formatted one (a date, a currency).
Put per-row quick actions (Edit, Copy) and a ⋯ DropdownMenu for secondary actions (Duplicate, Archive, Delete) in a trailing TableCell actions with TableRowActions.
Pair a selectable table with an ActionBar at the bottom for bulk actions on selected rows.
dont: Don't use a table for rows with one attribute — use a List.
Don't zebra-stripe; hairlines + hover are enough.
Don't nest interactive controls in every cell — one trailing actions column is plenty.
